text:
anna_ml: FYI I'm seeing nondet outputs from eval harness when running sampling-heavy evals (temp=0.8, top_p=0.9) across CI vs local.
sam_runner: Did you pin seeds?
anna_ml: yes seed=42 in runner. But two runs with identical seed produce different tokens for some prompts.
mike_infra: Any quantization or kernel differences between CI and local? q8h vs q4?
anna_ml: both on q4 and same model sha. suspect worker reuse + streaming/batch interplay.
taylor_qc: Can you share a minimal repro? logs/snippet
anna_ml: pasted small repro run command:
```
python -m eval_runner.run --config configs/sampling.yaml --seed 42 --model-path /mnt/models/ggml-v1
```
outputs differ across runs.
sam_runner: top_p sampling can be implemented per-token; if worker-level RNG state isn't saved between batches you can get interleaving.
jen_prod: also check if top_p sampling uses floating point thresholds that change with AVX vs SSE kernels.
anna_ml: good point. local uses avx512 build, CI uses avx2. Could be FP ordering.
mike_infra: I added a quick experiment: force deterministic sampler by using numpy.random.Generator(PCG64DXSM) and draw all entropy upfront. Try PR #3412 patch.
ci-bot: ci: rerun requested by mike_infra — pipeline: eval-harness (rerun)
sam_runner: other angle: worker pool reassigns sequence IDs; if batching changes token offsets, top_p prefix behavior can vary. Need stable batching in tests.
taylor_qc: For CI test, we should assert either exact tokens or a metric tolerance. Prefer deterministic test that asserts exact sequence at temp=0.0 and seeded sampling at temp>0 with fixed RNG queue.
anna_ml: I'll add a tiny test to tests/eval_runner/test_repro_simple.py to run 3 seeds and compare hash of outputs.
jen_prod: also add a debug flag to dump RNG state per worker: `--dump-rng` to help triage.
sam_runner: opened issue https://github.com/redwood-inference/eval-runner/issues/512 with notes
anna_ml: After PR #3412 + seed-draw-upfront I get stable outputs across CI/local on my branch. Will open PR.
mike_infra: nice. once PR is up, add CI job that runs sampling-repro smoke with avx2 build.
anna_ml: thanks all :party_parrot:
taylor_qc: :thumbsup:
